description: This file defines a factory class for creating instances of IGrainDirectoryCache with different caching strategies, as well as a null implementation of IGrainDirectoryCache used as a default or fallback.

classes.name: NullGrainDirectoryCache
classes.description: A no-op implementation of IGrainDirectoryCache that performs no caching actions and always returns default or false.

methods.name: CreateGrainDirectoryCache
methods.description: Creates an IGrainDirectoryCache instance based on the provided options, selecting between null, LRU, adaptive, or custom strategies.

methods.name: CreateCustomGrainDirectoryCache
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a custom grain directory cache, defaulting to an LRU cache if none is provided.
